name: Farmer Furlbrow
summary: Near the Jansen Stead, Farmer Furlbrow and his wife, Verna, are stranded beside their broken wagon. Driven from their northern Westfall farm by the Defias Brotherhood, they hope to reach Elwynn Forest.

sections.title: A Life Packed on a Wagon
sections.body:
The Furlbrows salvaged what they could and set out for Elwynn Forest. Theodore urged neighbors like Farmer Saldean to leave as well. Now bandits and wild beasts threaten them on the road.

Verna tends their horse, Old Blanchy, while Theodore keeps watch. He hopes to recover the pocket watch Verna's father gave him on their wedding day. He also wants to warn Sentinel Hill about the approaching bandits.

sections.title: Evidence of Land Seizure
sections.body:
Before the Furlbrows fled, Defias thugs pressured Theodore and took the deed to his farmland, which Verna had cosigned. They believed it could help them forge deeds of their own. The bandits still hold it.

You can recover the deed and return it to Theodore. If Westfall becomes fit for honest folk again, the deed could help the Furlbrows reclaim their land.

faq.answer: Driven from their northern Westfall pumpkin farm by the Defias Brotherhood, Theodore Furlbrow and his wife, Verna, fled together. They are stranded beside their broken wagon near the Jansen Stead.

faq.q: Why is Farmer Furlbrow stranded on the road?
aliases: why is furlbrow on the road
faq.answer: Theodore's wagon broke down as he and Verna fled Westfall for Elwynn Forest. They are stranded by the road with their horse, Old Blanchy.

faq.q: What heirloom did Farmer Furlbrow lose?
faq.answer: Theodore lost the pocket watch Verna's father gave him on their wedding day as they fled their farm. He hopes to recover it.

faq.q: Does Farmer Furlbrow have any family outside Westfall?
faq.answer: No relatives outside Westfall are recorded. Theodore's family is his wife, Verna, who is stranded with him beside their broken wagon and their horse, Old Blanchy.

angles.text: As an Alliance citizen, you see how completely civil authority has failed in Westfall. Loyal people must abandon their homes without royal soldiers to defend them.
